UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Guava Doctor farmer/user profile including full name and Bangladesh administrative location (Division, District, Upazila).

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the owner.

fullName.description: Full display name from Google Sign-In or Email/Password registration.

division.description: Selected Bangladesh division from the cascading dropdown (empty string for direct Google Sign-In until edited).

district.description: Selected Bangladesh district from the cascading dropdown (empty string for direct Google Sign-In until edited).

upazila.description: Selected Bangladesh upazila from the cascading dropdown (empty string for direct Google Sign-In until edited).

email.description: Email address from Google Sign-In or Email/Password authentication.

authProvider.description: Original authentication method bound to this email (google or password).

photoUrl.description: Optional Google account profile photo URL.

profileCompleted.description: Whether the user profile is active and ready for cloud sync.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the profile was last updated.

CloudScanRecord.title: CloudScanRecord
CloudScanRecord.description: Synced guava leaf AI scan diagnosis record belonging to an authenticated user, including migrated guest trial scans.

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the scan owner.

clientScanKey.description: Deterministic client-side key used to prevent duplicate uploads during guest scan migration.

predictedClass.description: Canonical predicted guava leaf condition class.

decisionScore.description: Linear SVM decision score for the winning class.

marginToRunnerUp.description: Margin between top-1 and runner-up SVM score.

allScores.description: Native map of canonical class names to numeric decision scores.

inferenceTimeMs.description: Measured on-device inference latency in milliseconds.

scannedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the leaf scan occurred on device.

mockResult.description: Whether the scan was generated in development mock mode.

localImagePath.description: Optional local on-device file path reference for the originating device.

EmailLock.title: EmailLock
EmailLock.description: Immutable privacy-preserving SHA-256 email uniqueness lock ensuring each email address can only be used once across Google Sign-In and Email/Password.

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID that owns this email.

provider.description: Authentication provider originally bound to this email.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the email was first registered.

/email_registry/{emailHash}.description: Immutable one-email-one-account locks keyed by SHA-256(lowercase email), isolated to request.auth.token.email.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated farmer profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/scans/{scanId}.description: Owner-isolated synced guava leaf diagnosis scan history records.
